dataset.name: HD-EPIC
dataset.license_or_access_note: HD-EPIC is released by the University of Bristol under CC BY 4.0. This source-aligned research clip was downloaded from the official data.bris.ac.uk record. A Benchmark Release must retain attribution and separately review redistribution of source frames.

original_annotations: Pick up both the larger plate and the smaller plate using the left and right hand respectively. [96.83, 97.75]
Place the smaller plate on the stack of saucers using the right hand. [99.05, 99.75]
Lift up the Tupperware lid from the stack of larger plates using the right hand to free up the space. [99.66, 100.84]
Place the larger plate onto the other stack of plates. [100.94, 101.43]

screening.proposed_initial_target: the smaller striped plate put away first
screening.proposed_later_state: the larger striped plate put away later
screening.proposed_instruction: Find the first of the two striped plates I put away. Add one visually matching plate to the cart and submit it.

supported_claims.text: V0 shows the smaller striped plate being put away first while the larger matching-pattern plate remains visible below.
V1 later shows the visibly larger striped plate being put away, without changing which plate was first.
HD-EPIC assigns the smaller and larger plates different physical-object associations and movement tracks over the released interval.

tasks.rejection_reason: The continuous video clearly distinguishes a smaller plate put away before a larger plate, but both source plates use concentric colored rings. The two frozen-site candidates use horizontal gray stripe patterns instead, so neither provides an honest visual match and the smaller source plate cannot be linked to a unique website entity.
